text: 22 Bethany raised her head and looked into Albert’s strained, bewildered face. “We have to go to sleep? How do we do that? I never felt less like sleeping in my whole life!” “I don’t know.” He looked hopefully across the aisle at Laurel. She was already shaking her head. She wished she could go to sleep, just go to sleep and make this whole crazy nightmare gone — but, like Bethany, she had never felt less like it in her entire life.
